summary: Reconcile current person asks without reading settled ask history

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection fold changes. Candidate selection starts from existing raw ready/pending step rows, exactly the states the existing cancellation loop evaluates. Legacy ask migration still runs first; each surviving candidate keeps its same-transaction raw status recheck and current ownership/attempt/generation/declaration checks.

schema.detail: Uses the existing step_runs_open_index and claims subject/kind lookup. No new table, index, trigger or numeric schema version change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No daemon API, client, wire, authority, admission, ordering or idempotency contract change. A store with only settled asks avoids a redundant writer transaction; current stale asks still receive the existing native cancellation.

downtime.detail: No additional startup migration or service interruption beyond the ordinary binary swap.

manual.detail: No manual migration, identity change or configuration is needed.

recovery.detail: Swapping back restores the broader candidate reads. No durable claims or projection state are rewritten by installing this reader change.
